description: Switches which connected browser the other tools talk to. Several browsers (or several instances of one browser) can hold a bridge connection at the same time; bridge_status lists their labels. Pass a full label ("chrome#2", or a user-set name like "work-chrome") for an exact instance, or a bare family name ("firefox") for the most recently connected instance of that family.

target.description: Connection label from bridge_status: "chrome#1", "firefox#2", or a bare family name like "firefox".

why.description: One short sentence shown in the Ui.Vision log: what this call does and why.

name: select_browser
